svg.title: One bounded source-coverage checkpoint
svg.desc: After the first source edit, read the real budget. Late tasks finish verification and submission. Otherwise inspect one relevant sibling or registration when the issue can span another path. A second edit requires source evidence. These are prompt instructions, not measured model behavior.

g.text: One bounded checkpoint after the first source edit
Exact V5 recipe: one 31B coder · 8 minutes · 28 calls · 80 turns · 240-second commands
Compile changed source · nearest targeted check · submit
No justified extra site: keep the first patch and report unresolved coverage.
≤60 seconds, ≤3 calls left, or ≥20 used: skip new reading
Only if issue may span another path
Original schematic. Compiler and scripted loop passed; native model adherence and quality are unmeasured.
